body:
## Goal

Close the semantic-atom campaign that #365 proved but could not ship: re-cut the frozen gate, re-falsify it end to end, and take candidate `127f2e8` through a fresh audit to merge-ready, carrying finding F-365-001 and all retained campaign-030 evidence.

## P1 user story

As a Lean auditor, I run the re-cut frozen gate and observe every blocking atom killed for the right reason, then I audit the exact candidate and report PASS with zero residuals.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Gate-v5 line-23 prose commented (one-line fix), gate re-frozen with new hash + supersession receipt (v5 → v6); full RED→GREEN re-falsification demonstrated on the new gate (a gate edited after falsification is a new gate).
- [ ] Campaign evidence retained from campaign-030 (79/79 atoms, 20/20 theorems, repaired runner, M0 control SURVIVED) re-verified under the re-cut (receipts re-run or byte-identical carries proven, never asserted).
- [ ] Fresh auditor (finite attempt cap + hash-bound preflight receipt frozen BEFORE first seat, codex-high or successor ladder, never muse) verdict PASS on exact candidate `127f2e8`, zero blocking findings, zero residuals.
- [ ] Candidate byte-identical to `127f2e8` (any model touch = new question + campaign re-run, no silent carries).
- [ ] PR #373 green (E2E red dispositioned separately), out of draft, merge-ready with lineage: F-365-001 → re-cut → acceptance.

## Non-goals

- Model/content changes (candidate frozen).
- E2E-withDevnet diagnosis (separate track; red is outside this branch per input-intersection evidence).
- Merging (project desk merges on green + acceptance).

## Parent

#367. Re-cut of #365 (closed-findings; second-findings closes a campaign — no repair bounce). Carries F-365-001 and campaign-030 evidence. Succeeds the to-365 lane; new runtime root on dispatch.
title: Semantic-atom campaign re-cut: gate executability + fresh audit (F-365-001)
